opening.argument: The presentation offers paid Coinomia Bitcoin-mining contracts, including a $10,000 option, and says contract mining power will generate bitcoins daily. It further ties greater earnings to recruitment, stating, "you will have to recruit more employees... and you will get more money." The account dashboard displays mining payouts, estimated income, and "Binary Commission For - 23 Users & 11 Pairs," while the registration form provides direct signup fields. These are concrete participation and team-earnings mechanisms. At the same time, the account page does not establish submission, payment, actual mining, or realized payouts, and the displayed estimates are not shown to be guaranteed.

citations.quote: They will then be able to generate bitcoins to you daily.
